# Best MagSafe car mounts (as of Oct 27, 2026)

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, about $47.99**
Three of the guides pick it as best overall. It includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, rotates between portrait and landscape, and takes cases up to 3 mm thick. Its vent slats need to be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, so check your vents first. ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)). If your vents are a poor fit, those guides suggest Belkin's vent/dash version, also about $47.99.

**Best for speed and reliability: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (MagGo AirCool), about $89.99**
- The Mount Guys use it as their daily driver. It has active cooling and a secure vent clip ([Mount Guys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)).
- The Gadgeteer lists it at a discounted $69.99 and says a 60W adapter is included ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)).
- The other guides say 25W needs a 45W+ USB-C adapter. They also say it isn't compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents.
- Not every phone gets 25W. The iPhone 15 and earlier generally get up to 15W.

**Best value with cooling: ESR HaloLock 15W Qi2 with CryoBoost, $39.99**
It has a built-in fan to reduce heat throttling in sun, and it mounts on a vent or dash. The Gadgeteer notes the car adapter may not be included, which adds $10 to $15.
- **Buy:** [ESR HaloLock 15W Wireless Car Charger with CryoBoost](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)
- **Discount:** Dealectric tested code **PARTNER18** (18% off) in ESR's cart on Oct 25, which brings the price to about $32.80. Enter it at checkout, since the store has the final word.
- **Affiliate link:** ESR pays Dealectric a commission on purchases through it, at no cost to you.

**Other options from The Gadgeteer's list**
- LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, from $39.95, with a 95W adapter included.
- PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2, $59.99, 15W, no fan.
- iOttie Velox Mini Qi2, $41.20, with a charger included.

I don't have direct purchase links for the Belkin, Anker, LISEN, PITAKA or iOttie mounts from these results. You can find them through the articles above, which link to Amazon.

**Buying tips**
- Look for "Qi2" certification. Plain "MagSafe-compatible" listings may charge at only 7.5W.
- Budget for a strong USB-C car adapter (30W+, or 45W+ for Anker's 25W) if one isn't included.
- Fan-equipped mounts help on hot dashboards.
